title.en: Has the number been encountered before

description.zh:
給定一個數字序列，確定是否已經遇到下一個數字。對於每個數字，如果已遇到該數字，則列印單字 YES（在單獨的行中）；如果尚未遇到該數字，則列印 NO。

C++ 注意： 使用 std::set 操作，例如 insert、count、find 和 set_intersection。保留請求的輸出順序。
description.en:
Given a sequence of numbers, determine if the next number has already been encountered. For each number, print the word YES (in a separate line) if this number has already been encountered, and print NO, if it has not already been encountered.

C++ note: Use std::set operations such as insert, count, find, and set_intersection. Preserve the requested output order.

hint.zh: 使用 set 的 insert、count、find、set_intersection 等操作；輸出集合時依題意保持排序。
hint.en: Use std::set operations such as insert, count, find, and set_intersection. Preserve the requested output order.
